content: Awař n SIDI x třařit n Isḥaq
Uca iḍhar SIDI i Ibrahim ɣar tcejjura n yigg n Mamri umi tuɣa yareyyeḥ ɣar wadaf n uqiḍun nnes di ṭṭḥa n uziř.
Issgeɛɛed tamuɣři nnes, iẓra, aqa din třata n yeryazen qibač nnes. Umi ten iẓra, ikkar ittazzeř ɣarsen zi wadaf n uqiḍun. Uca ibendeq s uɣembub nnes ɣar temmurt,
inna: “A Sidi inu, mařa řexxu ufiɣ arḍa di tiṭṭawin nnec, ttzawageɣ cek, war ɛeddu x umsexxar nnec.
Ejj imsexxaren inu ad dd-awyen cwayt n waman uca sirdem iḍaren nwem uca zzřem cwayt sadu tcejjart-a.
Ad dd-awyeɣ ařeqquz n weɣrum ḥima ad ttwaneɛcen wuřawen nwem, xenni ad teɛdum. Aqa x uya i dd-tekkim zzat i umsexxar nwem!” Nitni nnan: “Egg am mammec tennid.”
Iruḥ Ibrahim deɣya ɣar uqiḍun ɣar Sara, inna: “Deɣyat, ksi třata n řeqyas n waren azdad, eggw i-ten uca egg zzayes tifḍirin.”
Xas uca yuzzeř Ibrahim ɣar ifunasen uca iṭṭef-dd ijj n umeẓyan n ufunas igma d lemliḥ, iwca i-t i ubřiɣ, uca wa iqeǧeq, ḥima ad t issewjed.
Netta iksi ɛawed ddhen d uɣi d umeẓyan n ufunas nni issewjed, uca issars i-t zzatsen, u netta tuɣa ibedd qibač nsen sadu tcejjart, uca ccin.
Xenni nnan as: “Mani teǧa Sara tamɣart nnec?” Yarra-dd xasen: “Aqa-tt din deg uqiḍun.”
Uca Netta inna: “D tidett ad ɣarek dd-dewřeɣ ɣar řweqt n tudart u xzar, ad ɣares yiři uḥenjir ɣar Sara, tamɣart nnec.” U Sara tesřa ɣar wadaf n uqiḍun nni iǧan awarni as.
Ibrahim d Sara tuɣa wsaren, uyuren deg wussan, uca Sara tuɣa tbedd as tubbart n temɣarin.
Uca teḍḥec Sara deg wuř nnes, tenna: “Awarni tewsar inu, ma ad ɣari yiři řxir-a d lemliḥ qaɛ, am iǧa sidi inu uřa d netta iwsar?”
Inna SIDI i Ibrahim: “Maɣar teḍḥec Sara, tenna: ‘Ma zemmareɣ ad arweɣ am wsareɣ řexxu?’
Ma aqa din ca n řḥajjet x SIDI tewɛar? Ad ɣarek dd-ɛeqbeɣ di řweqt i negga, ɣar řweqt n tudart uca ad yiři ɣar Sara mmis!”
Sara tenkar, tenna: “War ḍeḥceɣ ca!”, minzi tuɣa teggʷed. Netta inna as: “Lla, aqa cem tḍeḥced!”
Taẓaǧit n Ibrahim x Sudum
Xenni kkaren iryazen nni ssenni, sewḍen ɣar Sadum, uca iruḥ Ibrahim akidsen, issqebbeḍ i-ten.
Uca inna SIDI: “Ma ad ffareɣ Necc x Ibrahim min i ɣa ggeɣ?
Ad yiři Ibrahim zeɛma d ijj n řgens imɣar ijhed, aqa ad dayes ttwabarken marra řegnus n ddunect.

Minzi Necc qqneɣ ixef inu akides, ḥima ad isseřmed iḥenjiren nnes uřa d taddart nnes awarni as, maḥend ad ḥḍan abrid n SIDI, ad ggen tasegda d řḥeqq, ḥima SIDI ad dd-yawi i Ibrahim min tuɣa xas inna.”
Xenni inna SIDI: “Tɣuyyit n Sadum d Ɛamurra temɣar aṭṭas u ddnub nsen deqřen.
Ad dd-hwiɣ, ad ẓareɣ ma ggin nican am tɣuyyit nsen i ɣari dd-yusin niɣ lla, ad ssneɣ.”
Xenni dewřen iryazen ssenni uca ṭṭfen abrid ɣar Sadum. Maca Ibrahim tuɣa iqqim ɛad ibedd zzat i wudem n SIDI.
Uca iqarreb-dd Ibrahim, inna: “Ma s tidett ad taredǧed ɛawed amsegged ak-d uɛeffan?
Aqa dinni balak xemsin n imseggaden daxeř i tendint. Ma s tidett ad ten taredǧed, u war tsemmḥed deg wemcan nni di ṭṭweɛ n xemsin n imseggaden i dayes iǧan?
Iggʷej xak ad tegged aya, ad tenɣed amsegged ak-d uɛeffan, wah, iggʷej xak ad yiři umsegged meḥsub am uɛeffan. Aqa řqaḍi n ddunect ma war ittegg s řḥeqq?”
Řexdenni inna as SIDI: “Mařa ufiɣ di Sadum xemsin n imseggaden daxeř i tendint, ad semḥeɣ i wemcan di ṭṭweɛ nsen.”
Ibrahim yarra-dd, inna: “Xzar řexxu, bdiɣ zeɛɛmeɣ ad ssiwřeɣ ak-d Sidi inu, waxxa necc d cař d yiɣɣeḍ.
Ad taɣ neqṣen zi xemsin n imseggaden xemsa, ma ad taredǧed x xemsa nni marra tandint?” Inna: “War tt ttaredǧeɣ mařa ufiɣ din xemsa u-rebɛin.”
Yarni deg wawař akides, inna as: “Ad taɣ ad yiři ad ittwaf din arebɛin!” Yarra-dd Netta: “War tt tteggeɣ ca di ṭṭweɛ n arebɛin nni.”
Xas uca inna: “War ttxeyyiq řexxu Sidi inu, xmi ɣa ssiwřeɣ ɛawed. Ad taɣ ad yiři din třatin!” Yarra-dd: “War tt ttaredǧeɣ mařa ufiɣ din třatin.”
Inna ɛawed: “Xzar řexxu, bdiɣ zeɛmeɣ ad ssiwřeɣ ak-d Sidi inu. Ad taɣ ad yiři din mɣir ɛicrin!” Yarra-dd: “War tt ttaredǧeɣ ca di ṭṭweɛ n ɛicrin nni.”
Xenni inna: “War ttxeyyiq řexxu Sidi inu, xmi ɣa ssiwřeɣ ɛawed. Ad taɣ ad yiři din mɣir ɛecra!” Yarra-dd: “War tt ttaredǧeɣ di ṭṭweɛ n ɛecra nni.”
Xenni iruḥ SIDI awarni řami ikemmeř awař nnes ak-d Ibrahim uca Ibrahim idweř-dd ɣar wemcan n tzeddiɣt nnes.
